prompt:
fix(bigquery,duckdb): don't drop array elements after a subquery (#8575)

inline_array_unless_query emitted ARRAY(<first element>) whenever the first
element contained a query, discarding the remaining elements. Only take the
ARRAY(...) constructor path for single-element arrays.

Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
test_patch:
diff --git a/tests/dialects/test_bigquery.py b/tests/dialects/test_bigquery.py
index b359107b5..c5b14fc47 100644
--- a/tests/dialects/test_bigquery.py
+++ b/tests/dialects/test_bigquery.py
@@ -1511,6 +1511,10 @@ LANGUAGE js AS
             "SELECT ARRAY(SELECT x FROM UNNEST([0, 1]) AS x)",
             write={"bigquery": "SELECT ARRAY(SELECT x FROM UNNEST([0, 1]) AS x)"},
         )
+        self.validate_identity("SELECT [(SELECT 1), 2]")
+        self.validate_identity("SELECT [1, (SELECT 2)]")
+        self.validate_identity("SELECT [STRUCT((SELECT 1) AS a), STRUCT(2 AS a)]")
+        self.validate_identity("SELECT [COALESCE((SELECT 1), 0), 2]")
         self.validate_all(
             "SELECT ARRAY(SELECT DISTINCT x FROM UNNEST(some_numbers) AS x) AS unique_numbers",
             write={
diff --git a/tests/dialects/test_duckdb.py b/tests/dialects/test_duckdb.py
index c1a339655..7f8811d93 100644
--- a/tests/dialects/test_duckdb.py
+++ b/tests/dialects/test_duckdb.py
@@ -2178,6 +2178,7 @@ class TestDuckDB(Validator):
     def test_array(self):
         self.validate_identity("ARRAY(SELECT id FROM t)")
         self.validate_identity("ARRAY((SELECT id FROM t))")
+        self.validate_identity("[(SELECT id FROM t), 2]")
 
     def test_cast(self):
         self.validate_identity("x::int[3]", "CAST(x AS INT[3])")
